body:
The frozen BDS-C candidate needed a common-3600-second D7 protection check and limited replication of its main development gains. This stage confirms D7's P-relative advantage and reproduces the S12/C2/D4/D6 conclusions without changing C++, parameters, defaults, or solver settings.

Stacked on R80 / #141 at `634cf03982e71849079699848ceecc3cd19ecb72`. Evidence commit: `b5b290d1ba940a82934fe7108cb1b20665fd8887`.

| Long role / common cap | P-GRB absolute gap | BDS-C absolute gap | Fresh K1-R absolute gap |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| D6 / 3600s | .006451687445 | .001726523844 | Not rerun |
| D7 / 3600s | .038698498372 | .014618557206 | .017135655033 |

D6's primary gap reduction repeats at **73.24%**, with worse U and stronger L. D7 improves P's gap **62.22%** (both U/L better) and K1's gap **14.69%** (worse U, stronger L); K1 P-advantage retention is **1.116733**. S12 certifies at P/BDS/K1 5.640/1.797/40.594s, C2 BDS certifies at 113.469s versus both controls open, and D4 BDS/K1 certify at 52.734/134.687s versus P open. All original/repeated endpoints are retained.

All 14 arms have valid audited evidence: **13 normal returns and one predeclared within-cap D7 P hard stop**. That P result uses committed physical witnesses and full-domain bounds; it is not normal finalization or a certificate. No rerun or retrospective deadline change occurs. The earlier invalid over-cap R72 run remains excluded.

Validation covers 269 source hashes, 436 physical witnesses, 22,534 global-bound events, 23,087 observed commits, 7 actual Start vectors/rows/readbacks, all 25 startup paths, 11 identical-cap repeated arms, and cross-run bound consistency. D7's separate cross-cap checks are not identical-cap replication. There are 52 Optimize starts/51 returns and 19,227.077 paid process seconds; all offline costs and transport failures are recorded. Fifteen lossless bundles retain 46,670 files and pass both package-time and standalone byte verification.

The stage also consolidates the complete source-grounded method and includes a reviewed checkpoint figure. No new optimization, qualification, seed, extension, or independent confirmation is added by postprocessing.

[Final report](https://github.com/yifanXovo/TailoredExact/blob/b5b290d1ba940a82934fe7108cb1b20665fd8887/results/unified_exact_round81/final_report.md) · [Unified method](https://github.com/yifanXovo/TailoredExact/blob/b5b290d1ba940a82934fe7108cb1b20665fd8887/results/unified_exact_round81/unified_method.md) · [Reproduction](https://github.com/yifanXovo/TailoredExact/blob/b5b290d1ba940a82934fe7108cb1b20665fd8887/results/unified_exact_round81/reproduce.md)

**Overall goal remains unmet:** these are exposed development roles. Next is bounded, structurally diverse, unadapted confirmation including nonzero medium/large proof roles. Keep the single frozen candidate; no main merge.
